title: Local CFTs extremise $F$
summary: Many CFTs can be extended to lines of nonlocal CFTs parametrised by the scaling dimension $Δ$ of the fundamental field appearing in the action. $Δ=\frac{d}{2}-ζ$ is set by the exponent of the kinetic term $(-\partial^2)^ζ$, which is nonlocal for noninteger $ζ$. If $Δ$ is tuned to $Δ_\mathrm{local}$, the scaling dimension of the fundamental field in the local CFT, arXiv:1703.05325 showed that we recover the conformal data of that CFT (plus a decoupled sector).
